defect: Initialize now sets the default temporary_directory on the instance config before Configure, which then overwrites it from the user/default config, and database_path is set only on config_ptr while Configure never copies it, so the StorageManager gets an empty path.
reason: The fix writes the temp directory into config_ptr and copies database_path in Configure, repairing exactly the reordering and the new database_path option this change introduced.

defect: ExtensionPrefixPreOpen clears config.options.database_path before knowing whether the extension handles the prefix, so a matching path that no extension claims silently opens an in-memory database.
reason: The fix moves the clearing into the branch where the extension returned replacement data, repairing a line added by this new file.

defect: The fix only removes a debugging printf from a C API test.
reason: Test-only cleanup of output noise; no product defect is repaired.

defect: The fix only re-wraps the long VectorOperations::Copy line for clang-format.
reason: Pure formatting change with identical semantics.

defect: The fix keeps the old step/max when nice rounding produces step 0 (MakeNumberNice of a step of 1 yields 0 because GetPreviousPowerOfTen(1) is 0) and drops the step-is-0 InternalException.
reason: The zero step comes from pre-existing MakeNumberNice/GetPreviousPowerOfTen logic that already produced an empty result before; this change only turned that into an InternalException.

defect: The fix replaces a stale loop variable i with field_idx after the loop was renamed.
reason: The original commit used i consistently; the leftover i (a compile error) came from later rename commits (18e0506..fd147d0), not from this change.

defect: TemplatedColumnDataCopy computes the validity pointer as base_ptr + sizeof(T) * STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE, which is misaligned for validity_t when the vector size is not a multiple of 8 for small types.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added line with an aligned GetValidityPointer; the same layout pattern also existed in InitializeVector, but this new copy path adds the misaligned write.

defect: The fix aligns the data size before the validity mask in AllocateVector and ReadVector.
reason: This change only split existing code into a new file; the same unaligned type_size * STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE computation was already present in column_data_collection.cpp before.

defect: The fix renames MacroBinding::MACRO_NAME to DummyBinding::DUMMY_NAME after a merge.
reason: MacroBinding::MACRO_NAME existed and compiled at this commit; the breakage was an invisible merge conflict with a concurrent rename.

defect: BindEnableLogging calls StructValue::GetChildren on the storage_config parameter, declared as LogicalType::ANY, without checking that it is a STRUCT, so a non-struct argument reads invalid value info.
reason: The code first enters the repository in this commit and the fix adds the missing STRUCT type check with a test for storage_config='hi'.

defect: In this header the fix only removes the ignore_errors parameters from the refine/eliminate/StructureToType declarations.
reason: The header lines are plain declarations and the fix to them is an API simplification; the actual defect repaired (skipping all children when ignore_errors) lies in json_structure.cpp.

defect: ListValueListFunction copies child data into the grandchild vector without reserving it for offset_sum, and computes nested list offsets by accumulation instead of from each input entry's offset.
reason: The fix reserves result_list for offset_sum and uses col_offsets plus the input offset, repairing an overflow and wrong offsets in the newly added function.

defect: The fix moves the caching checks into a new OperatorCachingAllowed helper; the real fix for issue 7988 is a chunk Reset in pipeline_executor.cpp.
reason: On this file the fix is a refactor of the same conditions; the else-if chain added here is not the repaired defect.

defect: The fix updates the create_sort_key.hpp include path after the header moved from core_functions to function.
reason: The include was valid at this commit; the header was moved later on another branch.

defect: The new ValueIsCastable uses undeclared value_ptr, size, vector_ptr, chunk_col_id, number_of_rows and state_machine and writes 'case default:', so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix rewrites these same added lines with dummy outputs, value_size and a valid default branch.

defect: The fix calls GetTotalRows after FinalizeAppend because GetTotalRows semantics changed later.
reason: Checking GetTotalRows before FinalizeAppend was the pre-existing order; this change only merged the null check into the condition.

defect: ShredAnalysisState leaves type_id and decimal_type uninitialized, so ConstructShreddedType returns an indeterminate type when no primitive, array or object count wins (for example an all-NULL variant column).
reason: The fix gives both fields INVALID defaults on exactly the lines this new file added; reading them uninitialized is undefined behaviour, not just a warning.

defect: The new ENUM ToString wraps KeywordHelper::WriteOptionallyQuoted(value, single quote) in another pair of single quotes, double-quoting values that need quoting and producing broken SQL in EXPORT DATABASE schema.sql.
reason: The fix removes WriteOptionallyQuoted from this added line, with a test for the export.

defect: The fix moves returned_chunk_count initialization from the constructor body into the init list.
reason: The member was already assigned in the body, so this is a style change with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix spells DEFAULT_BLOCK_HEADER_SIZE as sizeof(idx_t) instead of sizeof(uint64_t).
reason: idx_t is uint64_t, so the value is unchanged; cosmetic consistency only.

defect: WriteTemporaryBuffer increases the on-disk size by buffer.size + 8, but FileBuffer::Write writes internal_size (the alloc size) and DeleteTemporaryFile decreases by the real file size, so the temp-directory size accounting drifts.
reason: The fix changes this added line to buffer.AllocSize() + sizeof(idx_t); seeing the mismatch needs FileBuffer::Write in another file.

defect: The fix translates logical column ids to storage ids (for generated columns) before building the ART.
reason: This change only replaced the constraint-type argument; passing untranslated column_ids was already there before.

defect: The fix removes the VerifyConstraints declaration as part of splitting append and update constraint checks.
reason: This change only reformatted the header; the fix to this file is a declaration refactor.

defect: The enabled CHECK branch of VerifyConstraints evaluates the bound check expression, which references table column indices, on whatever chunk is passed, and Update passes the update chunk that holds only the updated columns.
reason: Before this change CHECK threw FIXME; the fix moves CHECK into append-only verification and makes update-path CHECK an explicit NotImplemented (the NOT NULL index bug it also fixes was pre-existing).

defect: Dialect detection now parses up to sample_chunks buffers for every quote/delimiter/escape candidate, multiplying sniffing cost and causing a large read_csv_auto performance regression.
reason: The fix, titled as a performance regression fix with a new benchmark, reverts exactly these added lines to a single TryParseCSV call.

defect: The fix indexes sorted_vector with state->position + j so later output chunks return the right rows.
reason: This change only reformatted the line; reading sorted_vector[j] for every chunk was already wrong before.

defect: The change drops subquery handling for ordinary table functions and treats a function as table-in-out only if it has exactly one TABLE argument, so functions such as the Python map function (TABLE, POINTER) can no longer take a subquery.
reason: The fix restores the subquery branch and relaxes the arity check to >= 1; knowing which functions take TABLE plus other arguments needs other files.

defect: MapFunctionExec loses its input chunk parameter while map.cpp still uses input, breaking the Python map table-in-out function (it does not compile).
reason: The fix restores an in-out signature with DataChunk &input and an OperatorResultType return, repairing this changed declaration.

defect: The fix reverts accidental reformatting of two lines.
reason: Pure formatting; the commit message says the wrong format was pushed.

defect: The fix (issue 6603) corrects the types used by the index join and restructures index-join planning to always put the index side on the right.
reason: The swapped left-index planning predates this change, which only moved the delim-join exclusion into TransformIndexJoin.

defect: The fix copies function.return_type into a local before moving function, so the deserialized expression keeps the decimal return type.
reason: Before the change the constructor already received a moved-from return_type; the new line depends on unspecified argument order, so the defect was not fixed, but it was not introduced here.

defect: The moved FullScanHashTable comments out the FillSelectionVectorSwitch call, so Gather runs with uninitialized sel_build and sel_addresses selection vectors.
reason: The original JoinHashTable::FullScanHashTable filled them; the fix re-enables the fill (with min-offset keys), repairing lines this change added.

defect: The fix removes redundant static specifiers inside the anonymous namespace for clang-tidy.
reason: Style-only change.

defect: PrintAllMetricsToSS writes extra_info into the JSON profiling output without JSONSanitize, which the previous query_profiler code applied, so quotes or newlines produce invalid JSON.
reason: The fix wraps GetExtraInfo in JSONSanitize in this added GetMetricAsString line.

defect: The fix adapts Node4::DeleteChild to a redesigned Prefix::Concat that also takes the Node4 slot.
reason: This change only rescoped the node handle; the Concat call and its arguments are unchanged, and the redesign follows the later iterative-delete change.

defect: The fix rewrites Prefix::Concat to receive the Node4 explicitly and handle a non-prefix grandparent.
reason: The prefix-chain freeing loop is correct for the recursive Erase it was written for (FreeNode clears the Node4 slot); the redesign follows the later iterative delete (303376f), which passes a grandparent that may not be the Node4 slot.

defect: Inner joins now use the cross product plus filter path only when the condition has a subquery, so conditions with correlated column references go through CreateJoin, which cannot handle them.
reason: Before, all inner joins took the filter path; the fix adds HasCorrelatedColumns to the condition this change narrowed.

defect: The fix removes RemoveGeneratedColumn and ChangeGeneratedColumnType and handles generated columns inside RemoveColumn and ChangeColumnType after generated columns were merged into the column list.
reason: After 29 intermediate commits the fix is a restructuring of rewritten code, not a repair of lines this change wrote.

defect: The fix removes the RemoveGeneratedColumn and ChangeGeneratedColumnType declarations.
reason: Header declaration cleanup following a later redesign; no defect in this change's lines.

defect: StartQuery now calls StartExplainAnalyze only after the IsEnabled check, but IsEnabled depends on is_explain_analyze, which StartExplainAnalyze sets, so EXPLAIN ANALYZE without profiling enabled returns early and is not profiled.
reason: The fix moves StartExplainAnalyze back before the IsEnabled check, undoing this change's reordering.
